remarks: Move-in Ready, better than new 4,000+ sq. ft. Silvermine custom built Colonial with 4 bedrooms, 4.5 baths is located in a bucolic setting, near the Silvermine Golf Course and the Wilton border. Beautiful cook's kitchen with stainless steel appliances, marble counter-tops, wet bar, island and an eating area that opens to family room and rear yard. Nearby powder room and mud room. Living room with walk-in bay windows and formal dining room. High-end finishes an millwork throughout! You will love the spacious 2nd floor with primary bedroom suite, spa bath with double sink vanity, radiant heat floors and 2 large walk-in closets. The 2nd bedroom has its own bath and the 2 additional bedrooms access a Jack & Jill bath. Over 1,000 sq. ft. living space in finished basement with full bath is ideal for a gym, office, and recreation area. Walk-up floored attic with high ceilings, spray foam & large windows ready to finish. Stepping outside, the property offers a spacious exterior with lush landscaping and ample outdoor space, including a charming architectural design, oversized bluestone patio, storage shed, fenced rear yard, stone walls and landscape lighting. A whole-house Generac generator and an irrigation system provide added convenience and comfort. The home is conveniently located near the Silvermine Golf Course, offering residents the opportunity to enjoy the tranquility of the surrounding area. And, it is just minutes from restaurants shopping, train stations and Merritt Pkwy
